csv_scope_of_work: This project includes a complete renovation of the interior layout and of the roof and roof structure of the existing USU Animal Sciences facility located on the North edge of the USU quad, as well as an addition to the north of the The State of Utah Division of Facilities Construction and Management (DFCM) is requesting proposals for Construction Manager / General Contractor (CM/GC) services for the following project: Animal Sciences Building Renovation and Addition building. The total gross square footage is just over 38,400 GSF in new construction, including just over 24,000 GSF of remodeled space. The Animal Science Building Remodel + Addition Floor Plans includes departments for Mathematics + Statistics, Academics, Shared Space, Tutoring and Collaboration Spaces, and Data Science / Artificial Intelligence (AI). Please note the program is being included, but has been revised and reduced in overall scope to align with the FY27 Legislative Appropriation.

title: CMGC for Animal Sciences Building Addition & Renovation
short_description: University building renovation and addition with roof structure renewal in Logan, Utah.
project_scope: Renovation and addition of the existing USU Animal Sciences facility on the north edge of the Utah State University quad. Scope includes complete renovation of the interior layout, renovation of the roof and roof structure, and a northern building addition. The project comprises just over 38,400 gross square feet of new construction and just over 24,000 gross square feet of remodeled space. Planned uses include Mathematics and Statistics, Academics, Shared Space, Tutoring and Collaboration Spaces, and Data Science / Artificial Intelligence.
services: Construction Manager / General Contractor (CM/GC) services for building renovation and addition; project includes rehabilitation/refurbishment and a construction delivery role with planning/design-build related disciplines requested.
relevance_explanation:
- Large university building project with substantial renovation and addition.
- Includes roof and roof structure renovation, which may involve structural engineering complexity.
- University projects can be strategically relevant for sbp.
- However, the tender is primarily for CM/GC services rather than direct structural design services.
- No clear indication of long-span, iconic, or highly innovative structural features.
fee_explanation: No explicit design fee is stated. The notice is for CM/GC services, not a direct engineering design contract. Available cost basis: total construction cost is 27.5 million USD for 38,400 GSF new construction plus 24,000 GSF remodeled space, including roof structure renovation.
references_qualifications: Disciplines requested include Design Build/Developer, Rehabilitation & Refurbishment, and Construction/Project Management. No specific minimum reference projects or qualification thresholds are stated in the provided text.
